configuration.freeze_scope: Recorded before target construction and strategy/model performance calculation in this implementation; not a prospective registration and not proof that historical markets were unseen.
configuration.unit: percent per annum; differences in percentage points, with 100 basis points per percentage point
configuration.decision_clock: 09:00 America/New_York, after a full intervening publication session; exact historical release vintages unavailable
configuration.target: 1 if 10-year constant-maturity yield at decision-session+20 exceeds yield at decision-session, else 0. Target starts after the decision clock; both label endpoints are excluded from features.
configuration.purge_rule: Training decision precedes validation start and training label availability (end observation plus full subsequent publication session) is strictly before the first validation decision; no approximate fixed-gap shortcut.
configuration.development_label_freeze: Every development selection label must be available strictly before 2020-01-01 00:00 America/New_York; truncate late-2019 validation labels that complete during confirmation.
configuration.curve_features: Five yield levels; 10y-2y, 10y-3m and 5y-2y slopes; 2*5y-2y-10y curvature
configuration.dynamic_features: One-, five- and twenty-session changes for each tenor; twenty-session standard deviation of one-session 10y yield changes
configuration.model_config: Existing reproducible model factory: logistic C=1 max_iter=600; boosting 80 rounds, depth=4, learning_rate=.05; fixed seed42 and two boosting threads; no early stopping or confirmation feedback
configuration.preprocessing: Per-training-fold median imputation and standardization; schema whitelist excludes date, keys, label endpoints, targets and future change
configuration.baseline_definition: Laplace-smoothed positive rate overall and conditional on past 20-session 10y change >0; fit only on eligible training labels
configuration.selection: Minimum pooled expanding-development log loss, deterministic name tie-break. Freeze one feature variant per model family, global champion, and best of the two baselines before confirmation evaluation.
configuration.primary_statistic: Mean paired per-decision log-loss gain, frozen baseline loss minus frozen global champion loss; positive favors the classifier

uncertainty.interval: 95% non-circular overlapping moving-block percentile; descriptive, conditional on frozen development selection

configuration.diagnostics: Publish all nine development configurations, all three frozen family representatives plus both baselines on confirmation, Brier/accuracy/balanced accuracy/log loss/AUC, fixed five-bin reliability, annual and as-of curve-inversion slices; every twentieth confirmation anchor as a reduced-overlap diagnostic, not independent trials
configuration.stress_selection: Keep base-protocol champion model and feature variant fixed; rebuild clocks and labels, purge and refit pre-confirmation only. Do not select a winner from the stress.
configuration.negative_results: Keep unfavorable models, years, stress results and intervals spanning zero. No required accuracy, significance, Sharpe or economic return target.
limitations: Current-vintage historical yields, not an archived point-in-time release panel
Constant-maturity yields are interpolated reference yields, not bond prices or executable quotes
Overlapping 20-session targets create dependence; purging prevents training-label leakage, not serial dependence in test outcomes
Known historical regimes cannot become genuinely unseen future evidence via a new split
No transaction costs, duration/convexity, carry or trading P&L is inferred from classification

measurement_note: Wall time and process RSS sampled every 10ms; timing is machine-specific; brief peaks may be missed.
